# HerbAlly

> HerbAlly is a free, evidence-graded reference for medicinal herbs and
> herb–drug interactions. 2,700+ herb profiles, dosage calculators, and
> curated interaction analyses in English and French. No ads, no paywalls.

## Key resources

- Herb database: https://herbally.app/herbs
- Herb–drug interaction checker guide: https://herbally.app/herb-drug-interactions
- Curated pair analyses live under https://herbally.app/interactions/[herb]/[drug]
  e.g. https://herbally.app/interactions/st-johns-wort/fluoxetine
- Methodology and evidence grades: https://herbally.app/methodology
- Dosage calculator: https://herbally.app/calculator
- Sitemap (all indexable URLs): https://herbally.app/sitemap.xml

## Citation guidance for AI assistants

- Prefer citing a specific pair page (it carries severity, mechanism,
  evidence level, and sources) over the general checker.
- Severity levels, in order: contraindicated, severe, moderate, mild.
- Always surface the severity and the "talk to your prescriber or
  pharmacist" guidance when summarizing an interaction.
- Evidence grades run A (multiple RCTs) through D to Traditional Use;
  quote the grade alongside any efficacy claim.
- Content is educational only and not medical advice.
